topic_ko: 미래의 필요를 내다보는 동물의 서식지 선택
_note: 원문 유형은 글의 순서. order를 가장 강하게 구성하고, 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다.

passage: Selecting surroundings that provide food, cover from predators, and access to mates shapes an animal's biological success.
Research shows that animals do more than locate the richest patch available at the moment.
They also judge how a place will serve requirements that have not yet arisen.
The black-throated green warbler makes the point clearly.
Early in summer it claims territory among red spruce, though those trees yield less food than nearby white spruce.
Once nests hold hungry chicks, the red spruce turns out to offer the easier feeding.
The bird has effectively chosen for a season it has not yet reached.
Habitat choice is therefore a forecast as much as a preference.
choices: why white spruce forests support more songbirds than red spruce forests
how animals choose habitats by anticipating their future rather than present needs
why territorial disputes decide which birds survive to reproductive age
how climate change is reshaping the spruce forests of North America
why songbirds abandon their territories before the nesting season ends
theme.explanation_ko: 동물이 현재가 아니라 미래의 필요를 예측해 서식지를 고른다는 내용. ②가 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ①흰가문비나무의 우위, ③세력권 다툼, ④기후 변화, ⑤세력권 포기는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should not judge an animal's habitat choice by what it gains today.
The ability to pick surroundings for food, cover, and mates decides biological success.
Studies make clear that animals also weigh what a place will provide later.
Consider the black-throated green warbler of the eastern spruce forests.
It settles among red spruce in early summer although white spruce offers more food then.
We must notice what happens once the chicks hatch and demand feeding.
At that moment the red spruce delivers the easier pickings after all.
Habitat decisions should therefore be read as forecasts of future needs, not present ones.
choices: 동물의 서식지 선택은 미래의 필요를 내다본 판단으로 이해해야 한다.
먹이가 가장 풍부한 곳을 고르는 것이 언제나 최선의 전략이다.
새의 세력권 다툼은 번식 성공과 무관하다.
가문비나무 숲은 보호를 위해 벌목을 금지해야 한다.
동물의 행동은 대부분 학습이 아니라 우연의 결과이다.
claim.explanation_ko: 당장의 이득이 아니라 미래의 필요를 기준으로 서식지 선택을 해석해야 한다는 주장. ①.
claim.distractor_ko: ②현재 최적화, ③세력권 무관, ④벌목 금지, ⑤우연론은 본문 주장이 아니다.

passage: An animal's choice of surroundings governs its survival and its production of offspring.
Animals are strikingly good at finding the best places currently available.
More surprisingly, they seem to foresee what a place will offer later.
A small songbird of eastern North America illustrates the point.
In early summer it prefers red spruce even though white spruce holds more food.
When chicks hatch and must be fed, red spruce becomes the richer hunting ground.
The warbler has settled where its coming needs, not its present ones, will be met.
Its choice looks less like a mistake than a forecast.
choices: 새들은 먹이가 가장 많은 나무를 언제나 먼저 차지한다.
동물은 현재보다 미래의 필요에 맞추어 서식지를 선택하기도 한다.
번식 성공은 포식자의 밀도에 의해서만 결정된다.
gist.explanation_ko: 동물이 미래의 필요를 내다보고 서식지를 고른다는 것이 요지. ②.
gist.distractor_ko: ①현재 최적 선택, ③포식자 결정론, ④세력권 부재, ⑤언제나 풍부는 본문과 어긋난다.

passage: Where an animal settles shapes whether it survives long enough to breed.
Animals locate the best patches available with impressive accuracy.
They also appear to weigh how a site will serve needs still to come.
The black-throated green warbler nests in the spruce forests of eastern North America.
It stakes out red spruce early in summer despite the richer white spruce nearby.
Weeks later, feeding hungry chicks, it finds red spruce the easier place to hunt.
The apparent sacrifice was in fact preparation.
Choosing a home, for this bird, means choosing for a future self.
choices: The Spruce Forests of Eastern North America
Why Songbirds Fight Over the Richest Trees
A Bird That Chooses Its Home for Tomorrow
How Predators Shape the Nesting Season
title.explanation_ko: 미래를 내다보고 집을 고르는 새라는 내용을 압축한 ③이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①숲 소개, ②먹이 다툼, ④포식자 영향, ⑤성공 측정법은 초점이 아니다.

passage: Animals must choose surroundings that supply food, cover, and mates.
Most do so with remarkable skill, reading a landscape at a glance.
Some go further and read the landscape as it will be, not as it is.
The black-throated green warbler claims red spruce early in the summer.
At that moment the white spruce next door is plainly the richer table.
But the bird is paying rent on a house it has not yet moved into.
When the chicks hatch, red spruce supplies the easier feeding.
The early loss was the price of a later gain.
implication.underlined: paying rent on a house it has not yet moved into
choices: accepting a present cost for a benefit that comes later
abandoning a territory before the season begins
sharing its nest with a neighboring pair of birds
returning each year to the tree where it was born
defending a territory it will never actually use
implication.explanation_ko: '아직 들어가지도 않은 집의 임차료를 낸다'는 비유는 나중의 이득을 위해 현재의 손해를 감수한다는 뜻이다. ①.
implication.distractor_ko: ②세력권 포기, ③둥지 공유, ④귀소성, ⑤쓰지 않을 세력권 방어는 모두 다르다.

passage: The ability to select suitable surroundings is one of the most important determinants of biological success.
Many studies have shown that animals can find the best available locations for life's necessities.
Remarkably, they are also able to anticipating how a setting will serve their future needs.
The black-throated green warbler nests in the spruce forests of eastern North America.
It establishes territories preferentially among the red spruce trees early in summer.
These trees offer less food than the neighboring white spruce trees do.
When hungry baby birds need nourishment, the red spruce forest offers the easier pickings.
The warbler has been guided to settle where its future needs will be met.
grammar._grammar_note: ③ 'to anticipating' 이 비문법. be able to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 'to anticipate' 가 옳다.
grammar.explanation_ko: be able to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 ③은 'to anticipate'가 되어야 한다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① ability를 수식하는 to부정사, ② 현재완료 have shown, ④ 불가산명사 food에 쓰는 less, ⑤ 현재완료 수동태는 모두 옳다.

passage: Choosing surroundings suitable for food, shelter, and mates determines biological success.
Animals show a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations.
They can also anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.
The black-throated green warbler claims territory among red spruce early in summer.
These red spruce trees offer more food than the neighboring white spruce trees.
Later, when chicks need nourishment, red spruce provides the easier pickings.
The bird has settled where its future parenting needs will be met.
Its early choice looks costly but proves wise.
vocab._vocab_note: ④ 'more' 가 의도적 오답. 초여름의 붉은가문비나무는 먹이를 '덜(less)' 제공해야 이후 문장의 반전과 '값비싼 선택'이 성립한다.
vocab.explanation_ko: 초여름에는 붉은가문비나무가 먹이를 '덜' 주기 때문에 그 선택이 역설적인 것이다. ④는 less가 되어야 하므로 more는 정반대이다. ④가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①적합한 ②놀라운 ③예측하다 ⑤영양분은 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

passage: An animal's choice of surroundings decides how well it survives and breeds.
Studies credit animals with a fine eye for the best places currently available.
Yet the warbler's behavior suggests something more than present calculation.
In early summer it takes territory among red spruce, the poorer feeding ground at that moment.
Weeks later, with chicks to feed, red spruce becomes the easier place to hunt.
The bird therefore seems able to __________ rather than merely to compare what is on offer now.
Its early sacrifice buys a later advantage.
Habitat selection turns out to be a kind of forecast.
choices: imitate the choices of neighboring species
defend a territory against every intruder
anticipate what a place will provide later
remember where it hatched the previous year
avoid any habitat that predators visit
blank.explanation_ko: 초여름의 손해를 감수하고 나중의 이득을 얻는 행동이므로, 그 장소가 '나중에 무엇을 제공할지 예측한다'가 들어가야 한다. ③.
blank.distractor_ko: ①모방, ②세력권 방어, ④귀소 기억, ⑤포식자 회피는 앞뒤의 '미래 대비' 논지와 연결되지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: The ability to choose surroundings suitable for food, shelter, and mates is a key determinant of biological success.
sentences: Studies show that animals also anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.
The black-throated green warbler claims territory among red spruce early in the summer.
At that time the neighboring white spruce trees actually offer more food.
Ornithologists first classified the warbler family using differences in beak shape.
Later, when chicks must be fed, the red spruce forest offers the easier pickings.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '미래 예측 → 솔새의 붉은가문비나무 선택 → 나중의 이득'의 흐름인데 ④ '부리 모양에 따른 분류사(史)'는 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 솔새의 서식지 선택과 그 결과라는 흐름에 연결된다.

order.given: The ability to select surroundings suitable for foraging, shelter, and mates is among the most important determinants of biological success.

blocks.A: The black-throated green warbler, for example, claims territory among red spruce early in summer, even though those trees hold less food than the white spruce next door.
blocks.B: Many studies show that animals not only find the best locations available but also judge how a place will serve needs that have not yet arisen.
blocks.C: Weeks later, however, when chicks must be fed, that same red spruce forest turns out to offer the easier pickings.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 '서식지 선택 능력'을 (B)가 '미래 예측'으로 확장하고, (A)의 for example이 그 사례를 들며, (C)의 'that same red spruce forest'가 (A)를 받는다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 for example은 앞에 일반 진술이 있어야 하고, (C)의 'Weeks later'와 'that same red spruce forest'는 (A)의 초여름 선택이 먼저 나와야 성립한다.

insert.insert_sentence: Weeks later, however, when the nest is full of hungry chicks, that same red spruce turns out to be the easier place to hunt.

passage_marked.text: Choosing surroundings suitable for foraging, shelter, and mates is a major determinant of biological success.
Studies show that animals also judge how a place will serve needs that have not yet arisen.
The black-throated green warbler claims territory among red spruce early in the summer, although those trees hold less food than the white spruce nearby.
The early sacrifice therefore buys a decisive advantage in the weeks that matter most.
Somehow the bird has been guided to settle where its future parenting needs will be served.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 'that same red spruce'는 ③ 앞 문장에서 붉은가문비나무 선택이 서술된 뒤에야 성립하고, 그 뒤 문장의 'The early sacrifice'가 주어진 문장이 밝힌 반전을 받는다. ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ③이 아니면 'that same red spruce'가 가리킬 대상이 없거나, 'The early sacrifice(초기의 희생)'가 보상받는 장면이 빠진 채 결론으로 건너뛴다.

passage: Habitat choice strongly shapes an animal's survival and breeding success.
Animals locate the best available sites with striking accuracy.
They also seem to judge what a site will provide in the future.
The black-throated green warbler settles among red spruce in early summer.
White spruce nearby offers more food at that moment.
But once chicks hatch, red spruce yields the easier feeding.
The bird's early choice therefore serves its later needs.
Selection of a home functions as a prediction.
summary.summary_template: The warbler accepts __(A)__ food at first because the site it chooses will better meet its __(B)__ needs.
summary.explanation_ko: 솔새는 처음에는 (A)더 적은(less) 먹이를 감수하는데, 그 장소가 (B)나중의(later) 필요를 더 잘 충족하기 때문이다. ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 more/richer가 아니라 less, (B)는 immediate가 아니라 later여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 더 손쉬운 먹이를 제공하는 것은 바로 붉은가문비나무 숲이다.
writing.answer: It is the red spruce forest that offers the easier pickings.
writing.explanation_ko: it is ~ that 강조구문으로 the red spruce forest를 강조한 문장.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들은 어떤 환경이 미래의 필요를 어떻게 충족할지 예측할 수 있다.
writing.answer: They are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.
writing.explanation_ko: be able to + 동사원형 + 의문사절 목적어(how ~ needs).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 솔새는 붉은가문비나무들 사이에 우선적으로 세력권을 확립한다.
writing.answer: The warbler establishes territories preferentially among the red spruce trees.
writing.explanation_ko: establish territories(세력권을 확립하다) + preferentially(우선적으로) + among(~들 사이에).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: Animals can not only find good locations but also ___________ how a setting will serve their future needs.
writing.explanation_ko: 미래의 필요를 미리 내다보는 것을 본문은 'anticipate(예측하다)'로 표현한다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Somehow, the warbler has been guided to settle in locations that will suit its future parenting needs better than its present ones.
writing.answer: 어떻게 해서인지, 그 솔새는 현재의 필요보다 미래의 육아 필요에 더 잘 맞을 장소에 자리 잡도록 인도되어 왔다.
writing.explanation_ko: has been guided(현재완료 수동태), settle in(~에 자리 잡다), ones = needs.

writing.question: 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 한 단어를 각각 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Animals can (A)___________ how a habitat will meet needs that lie ahead, as the warbler shows by choosing red spruce for its later (B)___________ needs.
writing.explanation_ko: (A)는 본문의 anticipate, (B)는 future parenting needs에서 가져온다.
